title: Intern, Quantum Applications
description:
PsiQuantum ’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers-machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.
Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.
Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry-including partners like GlobalFoundries-we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.
In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining-and that now is the time to scale.
PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies-including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical-to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.
Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift-and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.
Come join us.
Job Summary:
We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum , we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.
Your work could entail the -

• Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,

• Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,

• Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,

• Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,

• Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.
Desired experience and skills:

• Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.

• Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).

• A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

Build and own executive-facing reporting on core business metrics such as product availability, store performance, and inventory accuracy

Requirements

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.

• Build a library of well-tested, reusable Terraform modules with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, and comprehensive documentation.

• Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.

• Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.

• Manage Terraform state at scale with appropriate backend strategies, state locking, workspace organization, and disaster recovery patterns.

• Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.

• Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.

• Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.

• Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.

• Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.

• Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.

• Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.

• Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.

• Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.

• Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.

• Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.

• Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Who is Shift?

Shift provides business finance to small and medium businesses (SMEs) in Australia, including Business Overdraft, Equipment Line, Asset Finance and Trade Account. Since 2014, Shift has funded more than 30,000 Australian businesses.

At Shift, our unique approach to product innovation combined with our collaborative culture means you can build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll be joining a diverse team of over 300 people who are always looking to deliver better outcomes for Australian businesses.

About the Role:

Join Shift's in house legal team for a dynamic, hands-on role where your work truly makes an impact. As Legal Counsel, you'll split your time between broad commercial contracts and advisory work, and our specialist recoveries practice covering collections, workouts, caveats, and debt recovery. The recoveries work is a niche skill set - and we’ll provide comprehensive training. Enjoy the benefits of working in a small, collaborative team with opportunities for continuous learning.

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including supplier and merchant contracts

- Support loan, security and trade finance documentation

- 3 to 5 years’ PQE from a mid to top tier firm or financial services

- A current Australian practising certificate

- Strong drafting and negotiation skills

- Banking, lending or insolvency exposure highly regarded

- A commercial mindset and a willingness to learn a specialist area

- Bring Product the problems that matter most, backed by evidence from your customers, and follow them until they ship.

- Deploy Concierge as a fintech's 24/7 phone line, replacing cards and opening fraud cases without a human in the loop.

Help the team do the same by sharing what works, so AI removes execution barriers between disciplines and scales across the UX organization.

title: Co-Op, Targeted Non-Viral Delivery
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is seeking a co-op to help build the automated non-viral delivery platform. The role focuses on improving an automated system for production and characterization of targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNP).

Day-to-day work involves producing tLNPs to support ongoing experiments, developing new conjugation and purification methods for tLNPs, and applying those methods on the automated system.

The co-op works alongside chemists, biologists, automation engineers, and data scientists, with hands-on time across both bench science and automated lab systems.

What You'll Be Building

• Formulate and characterize targeted LNPs on an automated microfluidic workcell

• Run high-throughput screens of ionizable lipids and targeting ligands

• Execute downstream characterization assays such as DLS, RiboGreen, and TNS

• Onboard new workflows and experiment types onto the workcell

• Test and document changes that increase screening throughput

• Record methods, results, and observations in the ELN for reuse across teams

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a BSc or MSc in chemical engineering, biomedical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, biology, or a related field

• Hands-on wet-lab experience and comfort following detailed SOPs

• Data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret results and iterate on experimental design

• Clear written and verbal communication, including ELN documentation

• Available for the full January co-op term, onsite at Alewife

Bonus Points For

• Experience with lipid nanoparticle formulation, microfluidics, or other drug delivery systems

• Familiarity with automated systems or high-throughput screening platforms

• Familiarity with protein characterization methods

• Working knowledge of bioanalytical techniques such as fluorescence spectroscopy and electrophoresis

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

title: Benefits Program Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE PEOPLE TEAM

- Build the people function from scratch, fast enough to keep up with 10x growth. You'll build the systems, programs, and team from nothing, and make them work before we outgrow them.

- Reinvent people operations around AI. Doing this by hand doesn't scale to a workforce growing this fast on a team this lean. You'll put AI at the core of how the function runs, so a small team supports many times its number.

- Shape the culture and comms as the company scales. When a company scales this quickly, staying connected and aligned doesn't happen on its own. You'll help shape internal comms, events, and rhythm that keep a multi-site team that's growing fast bound to a shared culture.

ROLE SCOPE

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Du studierst im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master oder bist im Gap Year. Die Fachrichtung ist zweitrangig, wichtig ist, dass du herausgestochen bist. Du willst kein Traineeprogramm mit festen Stationen, sondern wissen, wie Entscheidungen tatsächlich entstehen: mit unvollständigen Daten, unter Zeitdruck, zwischen Menschen unterschiedlicher Meinung.

Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du verantwortest ein bis zwei eigene Themen und arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung.

DEINE VERANTWORTUNG

Analyse und Entscheidungsvorlagen

- Du nimmst eine offene Frage der Geschäftsführung, strukturierst sie und lieferst eine Antwort auf zwei Seiten, mit eigener Einschätzung. Dein Maßstab: Wer die Vorlage liest, kann danach entscheiden.

- Du baust Auswertungen aus unseren Zahlen: Ergebnisse je Einheit, Mandatsstrukturen, Auslastung, Wachstumstreiber. Die Daten holst du selbst, deine Annahmen dokumentierst du mit.

- Du prüfst Annahmen nach, die im Haus als gesetzt gelten, und stellst sachlich fest, wenn etwas nicht mehr stimmt.

Eigene Themen von der Frage bis zum Ergebnis

- Du übernimmst eigene Themen über die gesamte Strecke und trägst die Ergebnisse selbst vor der Geschäftsführung vor.

- Du arbeitest in laufenden Vorhaben quer durch das Unternehmen mit: Integration eines zugekauften Hauses, Aufbau eines neuen Beratungsfelds, Einführung eines Werkzeugs in allen Einheiten.

Interne Steuerung und Kultur

- Du baust an den Formaten mit, über die das Unternehmen gesteuert wird: Berichtswege, Kennzahlen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, interne Kommunikation.

- Du verantwortest Anlässe, an denen unsere Kultur konkret wird, von der Town Hall bis zum Sommerfest, gemeinsam mit dem Growth-Team.

- Du wirkst im Recruiting mit: Sichtung, eigene Einschätzung zu Kandidaten, Mitarbeit am Bewerbungsprozess.

DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du hast zwei eigene Themen von der Fragestellung bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet und selbst vorgetragen.

- Mehrere deiner Entscheidungsvorlagen haben zu tatsächlichen Entscheidungen geführt.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du verantwortest ein eigenes, abgegrenztes Thema, bei dem die Geschäftsführung nicht mehr nachfasst.

- Die Bereichsleitungen sprechen dich direkt an, wenn sie eine Analyse brauchen.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Du siehst in wenigen Monaten, wie ein wachsendes Unternehmen entscheidet, und nimmst eine Arbeitsweise mit, die in jeder späteren Rolle trägt. Wer überzeugt, bleibt im Gespräch.

Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) has a manufacturing facility located in McHenry, MS, just north of the Gulfport/Biloxi metro area, approximately 45 minutes from the Gulf. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions-signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Identity
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Corporate Security at Ramp owns the identity and access layer for the company: Okta, Google Workspace, the SaaS applications behind them, and the governance that decides who holds what. We are hiring a Senior Security Engineer, Identity, to turn that layer into IAM as a service - a platform the rest of Ramp can use without filing a ticket.

 

The role is hands-on. You will design how identity works at Ramp and write the code that implements it: identity configuration in Terraform, entitlements created and governed through an agentic workflow, and an on-call agent that answers access questions before anyone has to ask a person. As more access flows between applications and AI agents rather than people, you will own how those identities are issued, scoped, and audited.

 

You will report to the Corporate Security lead and work closely with IT, Security Engineering, AI DevX, and the Data team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Terraform for identity services: Okta applications, authorization servers, authentication policies, groups and group rules, and SCIM provisioning

- Design and operate custom authorization servers, including audiences, scopes, claims, and access policies for internal services and AI agents

- Implement app-to-app and agent access through Cross App Access (XAA) and ID-JAG, so delegated access is brokered and governed by the IdP rather than granted user by user

- Own our IGA platform: the entitlement catalog, ownership, access requests, time-bound grants, and certifications

- Build the agentic workflow that takes a team from "I have a new group of people who need access to X" to a defined, owned, and governed entitlement, with the Terraform and IGA changes opened for review

- Build identity graphs with ISPM tooling to target overprivileged and long-standing access across human and non-human identities

- Build the identity data lake behind an on-call agent that can explain events like a User Not Assigned Application error in Okta before the employee opens a ticket

WHAT YOU NEED

- 6+ years in identity engineering or IAM, including operational ownership of Okta or an equivalent identity provider at scale

- Deep understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM, including how custom authorization servers issue and enforce aud, scope, and claims

- Working knowledge of how XAA and ID-JAG work under the hood, including token exchange and JWT bearer grants

- Experience with ISPM or identity graph tooling, and turning its findings into automated remediation

- Experience owning an IGA platform or building the equivalent in-house

- Terraform experience managing identity providers, including module design, state, and CI

- Programming in Python or Go, with experience building against platform APIs

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

title: Senior Product Manager - Non-Human Identity Security
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager for Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security, you will define and execute the strategic vision for Delinea's non-human and machine identity portfolio. Non-human identities now vastly outnumber human ones, spanning service accounts, secrets, API keys, tokens, certificates, workloads, and, increasingly, autonomous AI agents. Your mission is to help the world's largest organizations discover, control, and continuously improve the security posture of every non-human identity across cloud and traditional infrastructure. This is one of the fastest-growing and highest-risk frontiers in identity security.

You will own the strategy and execution of Delinea’s NHI strategy that is standards-based to extend Delinea's leadership in discovery, control, and posture management. You will operate with a high degree of ownership, leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing key stakeholders, and ensuring the NHI portfolio continues to evolve as a market-leading part of Delinea's Identity Security Platform. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the United States.

- Own the roadmap, execution, and lifecycle related to the needs of privileged access by and identity security of workloads.

- Balance customer outcomes, technical investment, competitiveness, and business priorities.

- Define and deliver modern, NHI capabilities for machine identities across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

- Independently lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from ideation and market analysis through execution, launch, and ongoing optimization.

- Collaborate closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to deeply understand needs, validate requirements, and identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.

- Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, architecture, sales, marketing, support, and customer success to prioritize, deliver, and bring capabilities to market.

- Define adoption and success metrics, and use data to inform prioritization, measure impact, and demonstrate the business value of the NHI portfolio.

- Stay current on non-human identity, machine identity, and AI-agent security trends to inform roadmap evolution and maintain competitive differentiation.

What You'll Bring:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.

- 5+ years of proven product management experience, preferably in security or identity infrastructure software.

- Strong understanding of non-human and machine identity concepts, including secrets management, service accounts, certificates and PKI, API keys, tokens, and workload identity.

- Familiarity with modern identity standards and protocols such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, X.509, mTLS, and workload identity federation.

- Working knowledge of public cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native, microservices, DevOps, and CI/CD ecosystems.

title: French Speaking Go Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Language: French

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$60 - US$80 per hour

• Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

- Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

title: Amazon Account Health Specialist
description:
Amazon Account Health Specialist
Schedule: Full-Time | Monday-Friday | 9 AM - 5PM EST
We are seeking an experienced Amazon Account Health Specialist to manage and maintain the health of our Amazon Seller Central account. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience handling Amazon account health issues, opening and managing Seller Support cases, responding to policy violations, and monitoring customer feedback to ensure account compliance and performance.
Responsibilities

• Monitor and maintain the overall health of our Amazon Seller Central account.

• Open, manage, and follow up on Seller Support cases until resolution.

• Respond to account health notifications, policy violations, and performance warnings.

• Monitor and address negative customer feedback and product reviews when appropriate.

• Investigate and resolve listing, catalog, and account-related issues.

• Prepare and submit appeals and Plans of Action (POAs) for account or listing reinstatements.

• Monitor key account health metrics, including Order Defect Rate (ODR), Valid Tracking Rate (VTR), Late Shipment Rate (LSR), and Customer Service Performance.

• Work with internal teams to resolve issues affecting account performance.

• Maintain accurate records of cases, appeals, and resolutions.

• Stay current with Amazon policies and Seller Central updates.

Requirements

• Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

• Strong knowledge of Amazon Account Health and seller performance metrics.

• Experience opening, managing, and escalating Seller Support cases.

• Experience handling customer feedback removal requests and resolving account performance issues.

• Knowledge of Amazon policies, compliance requirements, and best practices.

• Experience preparing successful Plans of Action (POAs) and account appeals.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
